{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Stun1.png|thumb|right|250px|The blue-ring effect is shown here, by Imperial stormtrooper [[DV-692]].]]
{{Quote|There's one. Set for stun.|An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] before the capture of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Stun''' was a type of attack designed to leave a target incapacitated yet unharmed for a set period of time by overloading the target's [[nervous system]]. This overload generally caused unconsciousness although it could cause an almost catatonic state. Its main use was for capturing those wanted as prisoners.

==The Force and stun==
[[File:DeflectingStunBlasts-TJWKTM.png|thumb|right|250px|Ahsoka Tano dissipates stun beams with her lightsaber]]
Force-users could use Force powers called [[Force Stasis/Legends|Force Stun]], Force Stasis, and Force Stasis Field to stun enemies. Because these uses did not employ technology, they can only be compared to the devices used commonly by the effect they produced and not the means by which it was achieved. The physiological effects experienced by someone stunned by the Force would therefore not necessarily be the same as those experienced by someone stunned by a blaster.

Some Force-users, such as [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and his [[Horn family|ancestors]], could use the Force to [[Tutaminis|absorb]] the energy output from blasters set on stun, as well as that of stun batons and cuffs. This ability served the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] well during his quest to recover his [[Mirax Terrik Horn|wife]], who had been kidnapped by [[Leonia Tavira|Admiral Tavira's]] [[Invids]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref> Other Jedi could train themselves to [[Resist Stun|resist]] the effects of stun weaponry outright. Those who trained as [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinels]] generally practiced varying levels of [[Force resistance|Force immunity]], allowing them to withstand the effects of Force-based mental effects that included stun.

It was difficult to block a stun blast with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Admiral Daala used this to her advantage against [[Callista Ming]] on the dying ship ''[[Knight Hammer]]''. However, it was possible for a skilled lightsaber wielder to dissipate the stun beam, as demonstrated by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] using her lightsabers to deflect approximately ten stun shots fired at her by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] while she was on the run, being falsely accused of murder.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref>

==Physiological effects and dangers==
[[File:HowLuxGetsTheGirl-AFIN.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] uses a handheld stunner on Ahsoka Tano.]]
Depending on the design of a stunning device and the biology of the target, various physiological effects could occur upon being stunned. Some victims of a stun blast would remain conscious afterward, keenly aware of their surroundings but unable to move any limbs. Other types would knock a target completely unconscious, for easy transport or to keep a target unaware of movements through an area. Healthy humanoids could recover from a stun blast in as little as ten minutes<ref name="VG8">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp05.html|text=Episode IV Visual Guide — Chapter 5: Vader Confronts the Princess}}</ref> or as long as several hours, depending on the strength of the stun blast.

Most victims of a stun blast merely experienced nausea, dizziness and body aches for a short time, but the stun setting was not entirely without its dangers. Setting the stunning power to a high enough level could kill the target, especially a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]].<ref name="The Crystal Star">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref> Stun shots could also induce heart palpitations,<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> and the stun tentacles of the [[JK-13 security droid]] could cause irregular heart rhythm. Stun weapons had a greater than fifty percent chance of sparking a [[Reproduction|miscarriage]] in pregnant [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|women]].<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> The stun guns carried by [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] were reputed to cause temporary color blindness and minor dehydration upon recovery.<ref name="Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide real-life book">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>
